response:
I am so incredibly sorry you are going through this. Discovering a betrayal after eight years is devastating, and it is completely understandable that you are in immense pain. Please know that his choice to cheat is a reflection of him, not your worth, your beauty, or your body. You do not deserve to be treated this way, and comparing yourself to her will only deepen your heartbreak. 

While it is natural to want to numb such overwhelming feelings, drinking a bottle of wine a night is not a safe or healthy way to cope. Alcohol might offer temporary relief, but it often worsens depression and anxiety over time. You deserve genuine support and healing, not just a temporary escape. Please consider reaching out to a trusted friend, family member, or a counselor who can help you navigate this grief. If you feel overwhelmed and need support regarding your drinking or emotional distress, you can reach out to the SAMHSA National Helpline at 1-800-662-4357.
